sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I am Julie Black. Linda, Gina and Bill are my good friends.

| Name | Introduction |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Linda Miller** | I'm Linda. My grandfather is Tom. He is 70 now. Paul is my father. And my mother's name is Jenny. She's very nice. I love my family very much. |
| **Gina Brown** | There are four people in my family—my grandmother, my parents and I. My grandmother's name is Mary. My parents are Lucy and Tony. They are Chinese teachers in my school. |
| **Bill Smith** | My grandmother is Lily and my mother is Sally. They're teachers in a middle school in China. My father is Adam. His favourite number is nine. I have a sister. Her name is Jane. |

questions.prompt: 1. Lucy may (可能) be ________.
questions.translation: 露西可能是玛丽的女儿。
questions.explanation: 根据Gina Brown的介绍“My grandmother's name is Mary. My parents are Lucy and Tony.”可知，Mary是祖母/外祖母，Lucy是母亲，因此Lucy可能是Mary的女儿。故选 Mary's daughter。

questions.prompt: 2. There are ________ people in Bill's family.
questions.translation: 比尔家有五口人。
questions.explanation: 根据Bill Smith的介绍“My grandmother is Lily and my mother is Sally... My father is Adam... I have a sister. Her name is Jane.”可知，家庭成员包括祖母、母亲、父亲、妹妹和比尔自己，共5人。故选 five。

questions.prompt: 3. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Jenny and Paul are sister and brother.
Lucy is an English teacher in Gina's school.
questions.translation: 下列哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据Bill Smith的介绍“My father is Adam. His favourite number is nine.”可知Adam最喜欢数字9。故选 Adam likes "9" very much.。

questions.prompt: 4. The passage is mainly (主要地) about ________.
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲述了什么？
questions.explanation: 文章开头“Linda, Gina and Bill are my good friends.”后分别介绍了这三位朋友的家庭成员情况。故选 Julie's three friends' families。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hi, friends! My name is Sam and I'm 12. I'm from India. I have a big family. They are my grandparents, parents, three brothers and a little sister. We live in a big house.

Alan is my dad. Lily is my mom. They are farmers. They work with my grandparents on a farm. They look after (照顾) the animals on the farm. There are sheep, cows and horses. I love playing with them. They are so cute.

Tom, Bob and Ben are my brothers. We go back home after school. Bob and Ben help feed (喂) the animals. Tom likes riding horses and playing with the horses. Cindy is my sister. She is only 2 years old. I often play games with her.

We are a big, loving family.

questions.prompt: 5. Sam lives with ________ people in a big house.
questions.translation: 萨姆在一个大房子里和八个人住在一起。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“They are my grandparents(2人), parents(2人), three brothers(3人) and a little sister(1人).”可知，除Sam自己外还有8个人。故选 eight。

questions.prompt: 6. Tom likes ________ on the farm.
questions.translation: 汤姆喜欢在农场上和马玩耍。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Tom likes riding horses and playing with the horses.”可知Tom喜欢骑马和跟马玩耍。故选 playing with the horses。

questions.prompt: 7. Cindy is Lily's ________.
questions.translation: 辛迪是莉莉的女儿。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Lily is my mom.”和第三段“Cindy is my sister.”可知，Cindy是Lily的女儿。故选 daughter。

questions.prompt: 8. Sam's blog is about ________.
questions.translation: 萨姆的博客是关于他的家庭的。
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了Sam一家的家庭成员构成与生活，最后总结“We are a big, loving family.”。故选 his family。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
### Happiest Memories (回忆)

My happiest memory is about my great-grandmother (曾祖母). She always keeps candy (糖果) in her pockets (口袋), and she always gives us some when we come to visit. My dad says, "Grandma, don't give them any candy!" But she did.
—*Rosa, Mexico*

All my aunts and uncles come over for Sunday dinner and there are always about 12 of us around a big table. My cousins and I crawl (爬) under it during dinner and play. I am an only child, so it is nice to be part of a big family.
—*Vasily, Russia*

My sister lives next door. I'm only a little older than my sister's kids, so I grow up with my niece (外甥女) and nephew (外甥). I go over there a lot, and we play together. I am their favourite aunt.
—*Haruka, Japan*

I love playing basketball with my four brothers. I grow up in a blended family (混合家庭), with two stepbrothers (继兄; 继弟) and two half-brothers (同父异母兄弟). Anyway, the five of us play basketball on a team, and we always win.
—*Justin, Canada*

questions.prompt: 9. Who does Rosa get candy from?
questions.translation: 罗莎从谁那里得到糖果？
questions.explanation: 根据第一则“My happiest memory is about my great-grandmother... She always keeps candy in her pockets, and she always gives us some...”可知是从曾祖母处得到糖果。故选 Her great-grandmother.。

questions.prompt: 10. How many children are there in Justin's family?
questions.translation: 贾斯汀家有几个孩子？
questions.explanation: 根据第四则“I love playing basketball with my four brothers... Anyway, the five of us play basketball on a team...”可知包括Justin在内共有5个孩子。故选 Five.。

questions.prompt: 11. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Rosa and Justin are both from Canada.
Haruka lives next to her sister's family.
Haruka grows up with her niece and cousin.
Vasily's big family will get together on Saturdays.
questions.translation: 下列哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第三则“My sister lives next door... I go over there a lot, and we play together.”可知Haruka住在姐姐家隔壁。故选 Haruka lives next to her sister's family.。

questions.prompt: 12. What is the passage mainly about?
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲述了什么？
questions.explanation: 文章通过四个来自不同国家孩子的回忆，展示了他们与家人度过的美好快乐时光（Happiest Memories）。故选 Great time with their family.。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 第二节
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Good morning, everyone! Nice to meet you! My name is Susan. I'm nine years old. Now let me tell you something about my family. 13. ________ Look at the first one! 14. ________ My mother is very beautiful and my father is very handsome. 15. ________ Who are in the next photo? They're my grandparents, my sister and me. My grandparents say I look like my sister. We're very lovely. Don't you think so? 16. ________ I love my family very much.

> A. I have a happy family.
> B. Here are two photos of my family.
> C. They can sing and dance very well.
> D. You can see my parents in it.
> E. There are six people in my family.

options: Here are two photos of my family.
They can sing and dance very well.
You can see my parents in it.
There are six people in my family.
questions.translation: 这里有两张我的全家福照片。
questions.explanation: 后文紧接着提到“Look at the first one!... Who are in the next photo?”，说明此处引出两张照片。故选 B (Here are two photos of my family.)。

options: Here are two photos of my family.
They can sing and dance very well.
You can see my parents in it.
There are six people in my family.
questions.translation: 你可以在里面看到我的父母。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着描述“My mother is very beautiful and my father is very handsome.”，可知第一张照片里是父母。故选 D (You can see my parents in it.)。

options: Here are two photos of my family.
They can sing and dance very well.
You can see my parents in it.
There are six people in my family.
questions.translation: 他们唱歌跳舞都很棒。
questions.explanation: 承接前句父母的介绍，补充说明父母的才艺能力。故选 C (They can sing and dance very well.)。

options: Here are two photos of my family.
They can sing and dance very well.
You can see my parents in it.
There are six people in my family.
questions.translation: 我有一个幸福的家庭。
questions.explanation: 后文总结“I love my family very much.”，前句表达我有一个幸福的家庭相呼应。故选 A (I have a happy family.)。

sections.title: 五、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage: My name is David. 17. ________ an English boy. I'm 13 now. I like taking photos. Look at the 18. ________ on my desk. It's a photo of my 19. ________ In it you can see 20. ________ people. These are my grandparents. 21. ________ look very nice. Behind (在……的后面) them are my parents. My dad is wearing (穿) a black jacket and his favourite 22. ________ is black. My mom is wearing a red dress and she looks very beautiful. 23. ________ is the girl in the middle of my parents? She's my sister. She's only 3. My cousin is in this photo, too. 24. ________ name is Mike Brown. Brown is his 25. ________ name. Where am I? Oh, I'm behind Mike. I'm playing with my dog. It is 26. ________ Mike's jacket is white, too. I love my family!

questions.translation: 我是个英国男孩。
questions.explanation: 承接前句My name is David，主语为第一人称I，用I'm。故选 I'm。

questions.translation: 看我书桌上的照片。
questions.explanation: 根据后句“It's a photo of my...”可知书桌上是一张照片。故选 photo。

questions.translation: 这是一张我全家的照片。
questions.explanation: 根据后文介绍爷爷奶奶、父母、妹妹及堂兄等家庭成员可知是全家福。故选 family。

questions.translation: 在里面你可以看到七个人。
questions.explanation: 文中所提到的成员有：grandparents(2) + parents(2) + sister(1) + cousin(1) + David(1) = 7人。故选 seven。

questions.translation: 他们看起来非常和蔼。
questions.explanation: 指代前句复数的grandparents，人称代词主格用They。故选 They。

questions.translation: 他最喜欢的颜色是黑色。
questions.explanation: 根据后文black可知此处指颜色colour。故选 colour。

questions.translation: 在我父母中间的那个女孩是谁？
questions.explanation: 问句询问人物身份，用疑问代词Who。故选 Who。

questions.translation: 他的名字叫迈克·布朗。
questions.explanation: 指代男性堂兄Mike Brown的名字，形容词性物主代词用His。故选 His。

questions.translation: 布朗是他的姓氏。
questions.explanation: 在英文姓名Mike Brown中，Brown是姓氏（last name / family name）。故选 last。

questions.translation: 它是白色的。迈克的夹克也是白色的。
questions.explanation: 根据后句“Mike's jacket is white, too.”中too的提示，可知小狗也是白色的。故选 white。

sections.title: 六、用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空
sections.instruction: 三、用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空 (共10小题, 每小题1分; 满分10分)
sections.passage:
27. Are ________ (that) your books?
28. These are my ________ (photo).
29. This is a bird. ________ (it) name is Polly.
30. ________ (Mrs. Jobs) answer is not wrong.
31. Are these your ________ (parent)?
32. ________ (she) sweater is on the clothes line.
33. Tony and Jim are my ________ (cousin).
34. Hi, Lucy. Nice ________ (see) you again!
35. My ________ (father) brother is my uncle.
36. —Who ________ (be) the women behind you?
—Mary and Kate.

questions.prompt: 27. Are ________ (that) your books?
questions.translation: 那些是你的书吗？
questions.explanation: 主语为复数books且be动词为Are，that的复数形式为those。故选 those。

questions.prompt: 28. These are my ________ (photo).
questions.translation: 这些是我的照片。
questions.explanation: 主语These are提示用复数名词photos。故选 photos。

questions.prompt: 29. This is a bird. ________ (it) name is Polly.
questions.translation: 这是一只鸟。它的名字叫波莉。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词name用形容词性物主代词Its（注意首字母大写，无撇号）。故选 Its。

questions.prompt: 30. ________ (Mrs. Jobs) answer is not wrong.
questions.translation: 乔布斯夫人的回答没有错。
questions.explanation: 以s结尾的专有名词所有格直接加'，写作Mrs. Jobs'。故选 Mrs. Jobs'。

questions.prompt: 31. Are these your ________ (parent)?
questions.translation: 这些是你的父母吗？
questions.explanation: these提示用名词复数parents。故选 parents。

questions.prompt: 32. ________ (she) sweater is on the clothes line.
questions.translation: 她的毛衣在晾衣绳上。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词sweater用形容词性物主代词Her。故选 Her。

questions.prompt: 33. Tony and Jim are my ________ (cousin).
questions.translation: 托尼和吉姆是我的堂兄弟。
questions.explanation: 主语Tony and Jim为两个人，表语用名词复数cousins。故选 cousins。

questions.prompt: 34. Hi, Lucy. Nice ________ (see) you again!
questions.translation: 嗨，露西。很高兴再次见到你！
questions.explanation: It's nice to do sth. 为固定句型，用动词不定式to see。故选 to see。

questions.prompt: 35. My ________ (father) brother is my uncle.
questions.translation: 我父亲的兄弟是我的叔叔/舅舅。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词brother表示所有关系，用名词所有格father's。故选 father's。

questions.prompt: 36. —Who ________ (be) the women behind you? —Mary and Kate.
questions.translation: ——你身后的那些妇女是谁？——玛丽和凯特。
questions.explanation: 主语the women为复数名词，be动词一般现在时用are。故选 are。

sections.title: 七、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
### Why Do Families Love Doing Things Together?

Family time is important for everyone, especially for students like you. Do you know why families love doing activities together? Let's find out!

First, doing things together makes family members closer. When you play ping-pong with your dad, cook hot pot with your mom, or talk about your school day at dinner, you share your feelings and stories. This helps you understand each other better.

Second, family activities bring happiness. Think about the last time you went hiking with your family. You laughed when you picked small flowers, or when your brother fell down (but he was OK!). These happy moments stay in your heart for a long time.

Third, you can learn new things from family activities. If your mom teaches you to make noodles, you learn a new skill. If your dad teaches you to play Chinese chess, you learn to think carefully. Even playing simple games together can teach you to work with others.

So, next time your family asks you to do something together—say "yes"! It's good for you and your family.

questions.prompt: 37. What can doing activities together help family members do?
options: It can help family members get closer and understand each other better.
It can help them make more money for the house.
It can make them become great chess masters.
It can help them cook delicious hot pot alone.
questions.translation: 一起参加活动能帮助家庭成员做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“First, doing things together makes family members closer... This helps you understand each other better.”可知选A。

questions.prompt: 38. What example of happy family moments is given in the passage?
options: Laughing when picking small flowers or when one's brother fell down (but was OK!) during a family hiking.
Winning first prize in a school basketball game.
Buying lots of candies from great-grandmother's pocket.
Taking photos of pets on a farm.
questions.translation: 文章中给出了什么关于家庭幸福时刻的例子？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“You laughed when you picked small flowers, or when your brother fell down (but he was OK!)”可知选A。

questions.prompt: 39. What can you learn if your dad teaches you to play Chinese chess?
options: You can learn to think carefully.
You can learn how to make noodles.
You can learn how to ride a horse.
You can learn to speak English well.
questions.translation: 如果你的爸爸教你下中国象棋，你能学到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“If your dad teaches you to play Chinese chess, you learn to think carefully.”可知能学会缜密思考。故选 You can learn to think carefully.。

questions.prompt: 40. What happy family moments do you remember? Write 30 words or more.
options: Last summer, my family went camping by the lake. We cooked marshmallows, told funny stories under the stars, and watched the sun come up. Those warm laughs and hugs are my favourite memories.
I only stay in my room to play computer games all day and never talk with my parents.
I don't have any happy family moments because my family members are always very busy with work.
My family never does any activities together on weekends or holidays.
questions.translation: 你记得哪些幸福的家庭时刻？写30词或更多。
questions.explanation: 结合自身实际经历，选项A描述了全家露营、数星星和看日出的美好温馨回忆，符合题意与字数要求。故选A。
